about: Joel's Pangram history (the account he signed back into on 2026-11-02, read in the app's browser at his invitation, 18:16 UTC: "i signed back into one of my pangrams if you want to learn from that history"): of its 2,681 checks, the 27 places where a result of AI Detected or AI Generated was followed, within four checks, by a Human Written result on a text with most of the same words. "changes" is the word diff as read from the two checks' full texts ([-…-] taken out, [+…+] put in), cut at 300 characters; "words" is the AI-read text's length and "words_changed" the words in the diff. A "revision" is his edit of one text; "two texts checked seconds apart" changed most of the words less than a minute later and is two different texts side by side, which teaches nothing about one change. The links (https://www.pangram.com/history/<id>) are private to that account: they open for him when signed in to it, and read 403 for anyone else.
